integrity: Proof includes an exact all-width Dirichlet gap calculation and a conditional fair-sign argument; finite enumeration is supplemental and cannot certify the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Requires independent centrally symmetric nonzero rows in planar general position; does not cover dependent orientations, biases, or higher input dimension. Possible unlocated priority in higher-order circular halfspace-depth literature.
title: A distribution-free exact planar injectivity law for random ReLU layers
